description: This file provides a wrapper around the fetch API for making HTTP requests with error handling, including functions for GET, POST, PATCH, PUT, and DELETE methods, and defines related error classes and types.

classes.name: FetchError
classes.description: Custom error class for fetch-related errors, including HTTP status and message.

methods.name: httpCall
methods.description: Performs a fetch request with error handling, token management, and optional fingerprinting.

methods.name: httpPost
methods.description: Sends a POST request with JSON or FormData body.

methods.name: httpGet
methods.description: Sends a GET request with optional query parameters.

methods.name: httpPatch
methods.description: Sends a PATCH request with JSON body.

methods.name: httpPut
methods.description: Sends a PUT request with JSON body.
